where: crates/blaze-std/src/fs/journal.rs (Dir::changes_since), crates/blaze-cli/src/journal_sweep.rs, engine_check.rs's sweep call site
what: The write-only lane had no Grep or Glob tool in this session, only the REPL's typed rg/glob; and the certificate path saves nothing, so a stored journal place is never advanced by a request that stands on its certificate: the replay grows with every unrelated change (a README edit, a store write in the home) until a request writes its answer again.
cost: about twenty minutes finding signatures through the REPL; the second is a design note, not yet a cost
cause: Effect::Journal names only a FileName, so the driver's root (a checkout opened as Checkout::Here) cannot be journaled whole: the checkout's top-level folders are journaled one by one instead, and the first request after a cold one still sweeps them all (no place saved yet).
whys: blaze-core's FileName refuses the empty name; the root has no FileName
class: an effect that cannot name the root
fix: either a DirName in Effect::Journal (the root watchable), or the checkout always opened Named; and a certificate request that writes only the pointer's places when the replay told any event (one small record)
